info.title: FlashyOS wallet authorization plane
info.description: The deterministic layer between an agent's proposal and a signer that holds the keys. Every verdict, including refusals, is captured into the org's memory. Schemas referenced here are the enforced validators, published under docs/wallet/schema/.

agentToken.description: An agent token; the required scope is named per operation.

accountIndex.description: The derived account the agent acts from. Index 0 is the treasury.

address.description: Reported by the signer once derived.

Meter.description: Phase 19. A cap for one provider under one decision; ticks against it; one settlement at close.

ExternalSettlement.description: Phase 18. A SignedInvoice this org paid, refused, or is deciding on, with the plane-signed receipt once settled.

SafeAllowancePlan.description: Phase 17. The envelope tree as Safe Allowance Module transactions for a person to execute. Nothing here signs.

ProvenanceEntry.description: Phase 20. One wallet fact in the hash-chained export. hash = sha256(canonical(seq, at, kind, id, data, prev)); prev is the previous entry's hash, 64 zeros first.

Seal.description: Phase 20. A Merkle root over the export (leaves `<kind>:<id>` → entry hash, the brain's construction), signed by the plane's authorization key over canonical(version, org, seq, entries, through, root).

anchorCalldata.description: The 32 bytes a person may anchor on a chain.

TrustedPlane.description: Phase 23. A plane whose receipts this org accepts. kid = sha256 of the SPKI DER.

OrgSigningKey.description: Phase 24. The org's own Ed25519 key, public half. Outbound invoices are signed under the active one; retired ones still verify.

OutboundInvoice.description: Phase 24. A SignedInvoice this org issued, with the plane-signed receipt that paid it once accepted.

InboundPayment.description: Phase 25. Money that arrived at a receiving address by x402, one per EIP-3009 nonce.

X402Challenge.description: An x402 v1 402 body. Only scheme "exact" on a listed testnet is ever produced or accepted.

post.summary: Pay a partner org for a claimed broadcast, or pay its invoice
post.description: Either `invoiceId` alone (chain, asset, amount and payee come from the payee's invoice) or the five explicit fields. The payee's address is resolved from the payee's own registry and never accepted from the body. 201 ALLOW, 202 ESCALATE, 200 DENY; a refusal is recorded as a settlement too. When a settlement policy covers an escalated payment it is answered on the record as the human who set the policy and the result reads ALLOW with `autoAcceptedByPolicyId`.

get.summary: The delegations this agent has made

401.description: not a wallet:delegate agent for this org

post.summary: Carve a sub-envelope for another agent out of this agent's delegable envelope
post.description: The only agent path that creates an envelope, and it can only narrow: kinds, assets and destinations must be subsets of the delegator's; every cap at most the delegator's; escalation at least as strict; the children's daily caps together fit inside the delegator's, whose own spendable daily is reduced by the same amount. The target must not hold a human-set envelope on that chain. Every delegation is a recorded LOW decision. Superseding or revoking the parent revokes the children.

post.summary: Assign an agent its account index on a family; idempotent
post.description: OWNER/ADMIN. The index is the identity and is never reused; index 0 is the treasury. The address is reported later by the signer (POST ./address).

post.summary: The signer reports the address an index derives to
post.description: wallet:settle — the party holding the seed. An index derives one address, ever: a different address for a recorded index is ADDRESS_CONFLICT.

get.summary: The envelope tree as Safe Allowance Module transactions (Phase 17)
get.description: Members. A document, not an action: one addDelegate + setAllowance per agent with an envelope for the token on the chain, at its effective daily max. Agents without a recorded address are listed under missingAddress.

post.summary: Open a meter: a cap for one provider under one decision (Phase 19)
post.description: 201 ALLOW (open), 202 ESCALATE (pending a human), 200 DENY. Graded like a spend of the cap: kind `meter` must be on the envelope, the provider on the allowlist, the cap under perTxMax and today's budget.

403.description: not a member or wallet:read agent

post.summary: Record units and their cost against the cap; no decision
Reconcile the provider's count against the agent's and settle
post.description: 201 with the transfer authorization for what was used (bounded by the cap and the agent's count plus tolerance) when the counts agree within toleranceBps; 200 with METER_DISAGREE or METER_EMPTY otherwise, the cap released and the difference recorded.

post.summary: Pay a SignedInvoice from a payee outside FlashyOS (Phase 18)
post.description: The plane verifies the invoice (shape, signature under payee.publicKey, window) and then grades the transfer like any spend: the destination must be on the agent's allowlist. 201 ALLOW, 202 ESCALATE, 200 DENY (recorded as REFUSED). One settlement per (org, invoice id).

get.description: Public, no credential. Every SpendAuthorization and every SignedReceipt verifies under it. One key per plane; the org in the path is a courtesy.

403.description: not a member or wallet:read agent

post.summary: Trust a plane's key, or every active key of its plane document
post.description: OWNER only. { name, publicKey, url? } trusts one key; { name, document, url? } trusts a plane document's active keys, each checked against its own fingerprint. A revoked key trusted again is reactivated.

post.summary: Stop trusting a plane's key
post.description: OWNER only. Receipts already accepted stay accepted; new ones under the key are refused.

post.description: A wallet:propose agent or a member session. The destination is one of the org's registered receiving addresses on the chain — chosen, never typed.

403.description: not a member or wallet:read agent

post.summary: Void an unpaid outbound invoice
Present a SignedReceipt for an invoice this org issued (Phase 24)
post.description: Any agent or member of the org may present one; the receipt is trusted for what it verifies as. It must verify under a key in the org's trusted-plane registry or one of this plane's own, name the invoice by hash, and match it in asset, destination and amount. Accepted: the invoice is PAID, a receipt page is written, the brain hears about it. Refused: a capture with the reason, nothing filed.

201.description: accepted, with the invoice and which trusted key it verified under

403.description: RECEIPT_WRONG_KEY — signed by a plane this org does not trust
